newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco's public health staff plan two-day strike.
newsitem.headline: Morocco's public health staff plan two-day strike.

text.p: Morocco's 43,500 public sector health workers will go on strike for two days starting from June 25 to press for pay rises and other benefits, their union said on Monday.
He added that emergency services in hospitals and elsewhere would be provided during the strike.

"Doctors' status has remained unchanged for 15 years. We want it to be revised and salaries to be in line with other sectors," said a spokesman for their union, affiliated to the Democratic Labour Confederation.
The 3,500 doctors and 40,000 paramedical staff including nurses and technicians also want compensation to cover professional risk, he said.
